aboutGame.title: What is Normal Golf Game?
paragraphs: Normal Golf Game is a challenging physics-based golf simulator from solo developer Luke Muscat. Instead of a single swing meter, you control your stance, swing direction, club face angle and shot path, then live with the result on a huge course full of strange challenges.

Released on PC and Steam on September 21, 2026, it pairs traditional golf scoring with 100+ Bounties, 20 Steam achievements and a darkly comic story. Our wiki breaks down the controls, clubs, bounties and walkthroughs so you can play with a plan on every hole.

modules.name: Normal Golf Game Wiki Beginner Guide
modules.description: Understand the core goal, the basics of a round and the strange challenges that trip up new players.

highlights.detail: Learn the course layout, par, and how an 18-hole round is structured.
Build a simple half set: a putter, a few irons and a wedge are enough to start.
Treat tee shots, approach shots and putting as three separate skills.
Count every stroke honestly and aim for bogey golf as a realistic first target.
Keep pace with ready golf, repair ball marks and rake bunkers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Normal Golf Game.

items.question: What is Normal Golf Game?
items.answer: Normal Golf Game is a single-player physics golf simulator from developer Luke Muscat. You control your stance, swing direction, club face angle and shot path across a large course filled with strange challenges and 100+ Bounties.

items.question: What platforms is Normal Golf Game on?
items.answer: Normal Golf Game is available on PC through Steam and released on September 21, 2026. The Steam page currently lists English as the supported interface language.

items.question: How many Bounties and achievements are in Normal Golf Game?
items.answer: The full release of Normal Golf Game includes 100+ Bounties and 20 Steam achievements, so there is plenty to chase beyond a simple scorecard.

items.question: Is Normal Golf Game difficult?
items.answer: Yes. Normal Golf Game is built around a deliberately challenging physics system: you manage stance, swing and club face separately, so shots rarely land exactly where you expect at first.

items.question: Where should a beginner start in Normal Golf Game?
items.answer: Start with the Normal Golf Game Beginner Guide to learn the flow of a round, scoring and pace of play, then move on to the Controls and Bounties sections of this wiki.

items.question: Does Normal Golf Game have a story?
items.answer: Normal Golf Game pairs its physics golf with a strange, darkly comic story and a huge course full of unusual challenges and hidden secrets.
